scenario: [LUNI.2.4.1], with [RLOW.7.3.9]: the control for the -R refusal, so that it is not off by one. `unit u: data = x * 1.5 - 4611686018427387903` on an `int64` dimension has a = 3/2 and b = -(2^62 - 1), so P = 3, Q = 2 and R = -2^63 + 2, and -R = 2^63 - 2, which fits the 64-bit signed range. P, Q, R and -R all fit, so it compiles. A compiler that refuses an R near the bottom of the range, rather than one whose -R has no Int, refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_CONSTANT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
